problem.title: Social Media Shouldn't Feel Like a Full-Time Job
problem.subtitle: You started creating content to share your passion and grow your brand. But somewhere along the way, it became an exhausting cycle of posting, analyzing, and struggling to stay consistent.

pain1.title: Spending Hours on Manual Posting
pain1.description: You're juggling 5+ platforms, each with different formats, optimal times, and quirks. What should take 10 minutes ends up consuming your entire afternoon. You're copy-pasting captions, resizing images, and setting reminders just to stay consistent.

pain2.title: Inconsistent Posting Schedule
pain2.description: Life gets busy. You miss posting for a few days, and suddenly your engagement tanks. The algorithm punishes you. Your hard-earned audience starts forgetting who you are. You know consistency is key, but maintaining it feels impossible without burning out.

pain3.title: No Real Strategy or Insights
pain3.description: You're posting blindly, hoping something sticks. You have no idea which posts actually work, what your audience wants, or when they're most active. You're drowning in data across multiple platforms, but you have zero actionable insights to guide your content strategy.

pain4.title: Mediocre Content That Doesn't Convert
pain4.description: You stare at a blank screen for 30 minutes trying to craft the perfect caption. Your posts get buried in feeds. Engagement is lukewarm at best. You see other creators going viral while your content plateaus. You know you need better hooks, better captions, better strategy—but where do you even start?

agitation.story:
Imagine this: You wake up, excited to share your latest idea. You spend an hour crafting the perfect post for Instagram. Then you realize you need to resize it for TikTok. Then rewrite it for Twitter's character limit. Then adapt it again for LinkedIn's professional tone.

By the time you're done, you've spent 3 hours on a single piece of content. You still haven't analyzed last week's performance. You have no content planned for tomorrow. And you're already exhausted.

Meanwhile, other creators in your niche are publishing consistently, growing rapidly, and building businesses—while you're stuck in the weeds of manual busywork.

The algorithm doesn't care that you're busy. It only rewards consistency, quality, and strategic timing. And right now? You're losing on all three fronts.
agitation.callout: You didn't become a creator to spend your life scheduling posts. You deserve tools that work as hard as you do.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Get answers to the most common questions about Grow Online

q1.question: What is Grow Online?
q1.answer: Grow Online is an AI-powered social media management platform that helps creators and businesses grow their audience 10x faster through intelligent content scheduling, automated posting, and advanced analytics across all major platforms.

q2.question: Which social platforms are supported?
q2.answer: We support Instagram, TikTok, Twitter (X), LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, and YouTube. More platforms are being added based on user feedback.

q3.question: When will Grow Online launch?
q3.answer: We're launching in Q1 2025. Waitlist members will get early access 2 weeks before the public launch, plus 3 months free when they sign up.

q4.question: What makes Grow Online different from other tools?
q4.answer: Unlike bloated enterprise tools, we're built specifically for creators. Our AI actually learns your brand voice, our scheduling is intelligent (not just a calendar), and our pricing is affordable. Plus, we don't overwhelm you with features you'll never use.

q5.question: How does the AI content generation work?
q5.answer: Our AI analyzes your brand voice, past content, and trending topics in your niche to generate on-brand posts, captions, and hashtags that drive engagement. You maintain full creative control—the AI is a co-pilot, not a replacement for your creativity.

q6.question: Can I schedule to multiple platforms at once?
q6.answer: Yes! You create your content once, and Grow Online automatically adapts it for each platform's format, character limits, and best practices. Then it publishes to all your connected accounts with one click.

q7.question: Does Grow Online provide analytics for all platforms?
q7.answer: Absolutely. We provide a unified analytics dashboard that combines data from all your platforms. You'll see engagement rates, follower growth, best-performing content, optimal posting times, and competitor insights—all in one place.

q8.question: Is there a content calendar feature?
q8.answer: Yes. You'll have a visual content calendar where you can see all your scheduled posts across all platforms. You can drag-and-drop to reschedule, duplicate successful posts, and maintain a bird's-eye view of your entire content strategy.

q9.question: How much will it cost?
q9.answer: Pricing starts at $29/month for creators (up to 5 platforms, unlimited posts) and $99/month for agencies (unlimited everything + team features). Waitlist members get 3 months free and a 20% lifetime discount.

q10.question: Is there a free trial?
q10.answer: Waitlist members get 3 months completely free when we launch. After that, you can continue on a paid plan or cancel anytime. No credit card required to join the waitlist.

q11.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q11.answer: Yes, always. We don't believe in locking people into contracts. If Grow Online isn't right for you, cancel with one click. No hidden fees, no retention dark patterns, no questions asked.

q12.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q12.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, and Apple Pay. For annual plans, we also support bank transfers and invoicing.

q13.question: Is my data secure?
q13.answer: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption (AES-256), secure OAuth authentication for all platform connections, and never store your passwords. We're SOC 2 Type II compliant and GDPR ready.

q14.question: Do I need technical skills to use Grow Online?
q14.answer: Not at all. If you can use Instagram, you can use Grow Online. Our interface is designed for creators, not engineers. Most users are up and running in under 5 minutes.

q15.question: Can I import my existing content?
q15.answer: Yes. You can import your past posts from any platform to help our AI learn your brand voice faster. This also lets you identify your best-performing content and repurpose it across other platforms.

q16.question: What kind of support do you offer?
q16.answer: We offer email support for all users (responses within 24 hours), live chat for premium plans, and a comprehensive help center with video tutorials. Plus, our community forum connects you with other creators for tips and strategies.
